name: Resident Guest Scheme (RGS) Visa -- Legacy

requirements.blocker_text: Initial deposit of US$250,000 (or equivalent convertible foreign currency), with monthly remittance for personal upkeep and a minimum US$35,000 special-account deposit per dependent. As of this build, the Department of Immigration & Emigration's own page states this scheme is available only to holders already granted this visa seeking an EXTENSION -- not to new applicants.
Monthly remittance of US$2,000 for the principal applicant plus US$1,000 per dependent, in lieu of the investor deposit. Extension-only, per the same restriction as the investor category.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of satisfactory investment-project performance (investor category)
Educational credentials and work experience (professional category)

outcome.duration_length: 5 years from issuing date, annual renewal fee US$200/person

sources.title: Department of Immigration & Emigration, Sri Lanka -- Resident Guest Scheme (RGS) Visa: the page itself states the program is now restricted to 'foreigners those who are already obtained this visa (extension only)' -- i.e. closed to new applicants as of this build; investor category required US$250,000 initial deposit plus US$35,000/dependent, professional category required US$2,000/month remittance plus US$1,000/month per dependent; 5-year validity, US$200/person annual renewal

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sri Lanka). STATUS: PUBLISHED, BUT READ THE CAVEAT BEFORE TREATING THIS AS OPEN TO NEW APPLICANTS -- the government's own page states the scheme is now restricted to 'foreigners those who are already obtained this visa (extension only)', meaning this route is EFFECTIVELY CLOSED to brand-new applicants even though it remains real and currently operative for existing holders. This dataset's schema has a formal 'closed' status for exactly this situation, but that status requires a closed_date, and no formal closure announcement or effective date was located anywhere in this build -- inventing one would violate this dataset's 'never invent specifics' rule, so this route is kept as 'published' (all of its hard requirements ARE tier-1 sourced and currently accurate for the population it still serves) with the extension-only restriction stated prominently in the requirement text itself rather than in a status field. A user evaluating this as a NEW application path should treat it as closed in practice; an existing RGS holder should treat it as fully live. See lk_investor_residence.json (the Golden Paradise Residence Visa) for the program new investors should look at instead -- lower deposit (US$200,000 vs RGS's US$250,000), longer validity (10 years vs 5), and a different foreign-currency-account mechanism.
